name: hush
description: Keeps code comments useful: prevents redundant comments, preserves meaningful explanations and directives, and formats only files touched in the current task.

interface.longDescription: Hush guides coding agents to avoid comments that merely restate code, preserve meaningful explanations and tool directives, limit cleanup to code changed in the current task, and use the project's existing formatter.
capabilities: Keep comments that explain intent, constraints, or invariants
Remove redundant comments from code changed in the current task
Use the project's existing formatter on touched files
defaultPrompt: Use Hush when editing this code and keep comments useful.
Review my latest changes for redundant comments without touching unrelated code.
